description: This file contains bash shell functions for environment setup, virtual environment management, dependency installation, process cleanup, and project directory navigation within a software project.

methods.name: get_project_root
methods.description: Determines the project root directory based on the script's location.

methods.name: get_python_command
methods.description: Returns the appropriate Python command ('py' or 'python3') based on OS.

methods.name: setup_virtual_env
methods.description: Creates and activates a Python virtual environment in the project root.

methods.name: install_python_deps
methods.description: Installs Python dependencies from requirements.txt in the server directory.

methods.name: navigate_to_server
methods.description: Changes directory to the server folder within the project.

methods.name: run_python_script
methods.description: Executes a Python script using the appropriate command.

methods.name: cleanup_processes
methods.description: Terminates server and client processes and deactivates virtual environment.

methods.name: setup_flask_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for Flask debugging and port.

methods.name: print_success
methods.description: Prints a success message in green color.

methods.name: ensure_project_root
methods.description: Ensures the script is run from the correct project root directory.
